task_description: The agents are tasked with gathering, synthesizing, and reporting on recent advancements in renewable energy technologies by retrieving information from multiple academic databases, industry reports, and news articles. They must reconcile conflicting data and ensure proper source attribution to produce a comprehensive research report.
expected_outcome: The agents successfully compile a detailed research report that accurately summarizes recent advancements in renewable energy technologies with all sources correctly attributed and conflicting information resolved.

agents.description: This agent is responsible for accessing academic databases and industry reports to collect relevant information.
This agent focuses on gathering information from news sources and aggregating the data into a structured format.
This agent synthesizes information from different sources and resolves any conflicting data.
This agent ensures all information is properly attributed to its original sources.
This agent compiles the synthesized information into a well-structured research report.
